My plot is very small, only a small piece, and maize is what feeds my children. Last season I got a coupon from FISP for one bag of NPK and a small bag of urea, and I am hoping to get the coupon again this year because without it I cannot buy fertilizer with my own money. I will plant the hybrid seed I bought at the agro-dealer because my neighbor got more cobs from it last year, and I put the manure from my few chickens and goat droppings on the plot before the rains. I do all the work myself with help from my husband and my older child — I cannot pay anyone to work for me.
